retrieval.hit_requirement: matching document_id and physical PDF page plus normalized evidence quote contained in retrieved chunk
retrieval.test_policy: The previously inspected test set is retained as historical_test and excluded from current scores. The active test-v2 questions and evidence were fixed before corrected retrieval runs. Do not change code/config/gold after test-v2 is viewed; if changes follow, disclose and prepare another fresh holdout.

filter_policy: Only strategy C applies the chapter filter, and only where the question explicitly names the chapter. A and B never filter.

protocol_note: An exploratory dev aggregate and the original eight-question test were inspected before this protocol revision. The original test is retained as historical_test, never combined with current scores. This eight-question active test-v2 was authored from source pages not used by the original test and its gold quotes were checked against extracted source before corrected retrieval; the student must still verify every gold fully supports its expected answer. Five-question manual audit sample was set here before current retrieval.
human_review: Coherence and grounding ratings must be recorded with reasons; do not present AI-assisted ratings as independent student ratings.
manual_review: The student must inspect the fixed coherence anchors, metadata rows, and grounding sample, enter a 0-2 score with a reason, and record evaluator and date. Current labels are blank until this is done.
